items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Lil Armstrong's relationship with Louis Armstrong ('She taught him how to read...') but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Louis Armstrong himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, and then she'd play those songs, 'Pardon, Pardon,' and she'd play all of these songs from France, and then she played a lot of her original things. She never did get credit for 'Strutting with Barbecue' and --
Well, they just had L. Armstrong, but it was Lil.

Lil Armstrong. See, she used to write -- see, Louis at that particular time was just more or less an ear type musician. She taught him how to read and things like that. She taught him a lot of things. And -- but she was the one that was really writing the tunes, and then when they would go into the studios, well, they would change the names on them. You know how the record business has always been shady like that.
